summary: The source-checkout installation/lifecycle, substantial real CSE/model evidence, English video, source-mapped Three.js presentation and Korean guide are present and reviewable. The required grounded Codex onboarding handoff remains unverified in this immutable candidate: its latest completed semantic response states the wrong airflow unit after the harness omitted units. Presentation protocol labels also need small source-consistency corrections. Public article/video hosting is honestly pending and is a separate handoff, not a reason to fabricate public evidence.
snapshot_boundary: All substantive source, documents, evidence and images were read from a git archive of reviewed_commit. Working-tree fixes and any later unit-preserving model validation are excluded. This report does not approve a future inference call or predict its result.

criterion_verdicts.name: Quality of Article
criterion_verdicts.assessment: Draft covers the concrete sourced problem, virtual equipment, architecture/resources, native services and protocols, trust boundaries, reproducible setup, failure-derived insights and specific oneM2M benefits. It carefully separates health/physical outcomes and retained model failures. The combined protocol figure/paragraph needs explicit alternative-profile scope as described in FT2-02. Public Hackster publication, final video URL and public access are not established.

criterion_verdicts.name: Quality of Video
criterion_verdicts.assessment: The 108-second film has a coherent opening problem, readable original graphics, actual edited dashboard captures, English narration/captions, a recorded model trace, separate ACK/recovery/non-recovery and reuse. Reasonable production effort and an understandable narrative are visible. It identifies simulated physical data, historical recorded runs and CLI transport versus model execution. Public hosting is pending; the video does not prove a completed manager onboarding interaction.

criterion_verdicts.name: Quality of Github
criterion_verdicts.assessment: Standalone README explains purpose, pinned install, source navigation, diagnostics, account-free real-CSE fixture, extension paths and lifecycle. Fresh copied source/two environments/HTTPS CSE execution includes pending-state restart and cleanup preservation. Tested scope is macOS arm64/Python 3.12 and Codex CLI 0.166.0 source checkout; wheel-only installation, other OS acceptance, desktop UI and a human first-use study remain unclaimed. Plugin installation and actual model-selected tools exist, but the required grounded final Codex user explanation is not yet established. Article backlink remains an honest external publication handoff; no full Expert claim is established now.

criterion_verdicts.name: Promotion of oneM2M
criterion_verdicts.assessment: Materials explain the actual discovery/subscription/group/ACP and sharing functions, adapter-only vendor replacement and unchanged operational code. They distinguish application-specific policy from standard common services and acknowledge that a single-vendor system could be simpler. Protocol/profile labels must agree across article and interactive source map. Public reach or completed submission is not inferred from prepared files.

findings.gap_and_impact: The completed explanation says 200 L/min; the original captured measurement is 200 m³/h. The harness selected only values, omitting original measurement units/timestamps/provenance. This establishes a lossy validation input plus an unsupported model inference, not a missing-unit backend defect. A manager cannot rely on this as the required factually grounded handoff.
findings.minimum_change: Preserve this failure and all exhausted cases. Complete a transparently versioned measurement-complete input integrity check and an actual grounded user handoff under a main-approved finite scope within the unchanged shared batch. The proposed future stricter profile or corrected-input test is not evidence in this candidate. Do not edit the old answer or waive the gate.
findings.product_reason: Correct measurements and action history are core adoption requirements; successful transport or a complete sentence does not establish reliable operational guidance.
findings.verification: Independent source mapping confirms all previously chosen facts plus exact units/timestamps/source/quality survive the transformation, and an actually completed final answer preserves those facts, historical/simulation scope, prior ACK versus recovery, unresolved state and permission limits. No additional full installation/tool replay or desktop/human study is imposed.

findings.gap_and_impact: The interactive standard PM2.5 projection edge labels the single secure profile as HTTPS, but publish selects self.mqtt for that SDT update when MQTT is enabled. The article's combined diagram/paragraph can also read as one deployment using both secure device bindings and a central distributed CSE, even though the distributed demonstration uses HTTP and is separate. Correct surrounding caveats do not fix an incorrect selected edge label.
findings.minimum_change: Label the secure SDT update as native MQTT/TLS and explicitly caption or separate the secure-single and distributed-HTTP article paths. Update the exported source map and affected artifact hashes. This agrees with the protocol owners' presentation correction; no backend rewrite or new protocol feature is needed.
findings.product_reason: The project's oneM2M value must be understandable without asking readers to reconcile contradictory profile details.
findings.verification: A narrow correction snapshot shows labels matching Core.publish and the actual secure/distributed evidence; selected inspector text, article caption, source map and release manifest agree. Refresh affected visual QA only where displayed behavior changed.

findings.gap_and_impact: The public observer/recorder metadata still contains internal session identifiers. These are not credentials, but they are unnecessary, session-specific public metadata and repeat an earlier portability concern.
findings.minimum_change: Use stable public role labels and retain an explicit metadata-only redaction note. Preserve the observation attribution, source/capture hashes and the fact that the recorder did not conduct the UI observations.
findings.product_reason: Public evidence should be intelligible and reusable across sessions without exposing internal coordination handles.
findings.verification: The revised record has role labels while its substantive observations and referenced screenshot/source hashes remain unchanged.

publication_verdict.assessment: Current disclosure and handoff are honest. These external actions do not earn public-evidence credit now and do not authorize this reviewer to perform them. Their absence is not an invented zero or N/A.

limitations_and_followup: This exact candidate cannot be declared fully complete because a required factual onboarding outcome remains open.
Main-reported working-tree caption/metadata changes and any later model run need their own immutable correction snapshot and narrow independent verification; they are not silently included here.

Source-checkout support and explicit maintainer prerequisites are reasonable current release limits. A downloadable package, other OS, desktop wizard, human study or real-device pilot remains useful future work, not a new blocker imposed by this review.
No official rubric score, aggregate, eligibility ruling, clinical/physical performance, MEC deployment or completion of public submission is established.
reviewer_actions: Only this review file was written in the shared repository. All inspected candidate files came from an isolated immutable archive. Offline tests/media decode made no provider requests and did not mutate running application/CSE/profiles or host settings.
